thread:
maria: Quick check-in on Novus onboarding — noticed a p99 spike on /completions yesterday evening, pushing customer UX lag. anyone watching?
ashwin: Yup saw it. p99 for streaming calls to model gptx-8q jumped to ~2.1s around 20:15 UTC; non-streaming stayed ~600-700ms. Logs show a handful of long tail KV-cache misses.
telemetry-bot: automated summary for 2026-03-20 18:00-21:00 UTC:
 - route: /completions (streaming) p95=420ms p99=2100ms
 - route: /completions (non-stream) p95=580ms p99=650ms
 - top model: gptx-8q (80% of traffic)
 - error rate: 0.6% (retry-related spikes)
 - spend delta: +12% vs weekly avg
ashwin: thanks bot. initial investigation: a small fraction of sessions hit cache regeneration concurrently, causing serialization delays. Also saw elevated retries from client-side timeouts.
liam: flagging renewal risk here — Novus is in month 10 of trial and noticed billing jump. they pinged about perceived instability. recommend a quick enablement + credits to smooth renewal.
maria: agreed. Proposed immediate actions: 1) temporary routing to gptx-8q-quant (lower mem path) for heavy sessions, 2) enable small batching tweak on their tenant (batch window +8ms), 3) run prefix-cache warmup job for sessions that started in last 24h.
ashwin: will run a canary with those settings on staging then roll to their dedicated pool if stable. I'll post perf numbers in this thread. ETA 2 hours.
novus-admin: appreciate the quick turn. We saw the UI spinner for long responses; users got worried. If you can reduce the p99 below 1s that would calm them.
telemetry-bot: follow-up snapshot about 30m after changes:
 - canary (gptx-8q-quant + batching + warmup): streaming p95=390ms p99=980ms
 - non-streaming unaffected: p95=560ms p99=640ms
 - error rate dropped to 0.15%
 - projected weekly spend delta if rolled = +3% (vs +12%)
liam: good win. I'll open a renewal play with solutions + a $5k credit offer and schedule a 30-min sync with Novus tomorrow.
maria: great. next steps: ashwin to confirm rollout checklist + SLO guardrails, liam to own customer comms, i'll add notes to the account playbook and update CS dashboard. thanks all :thumbsup:
ashwin: filed SRE ticket: https://redwood.internal/boards/ABC-412 (canary -> prod rollout checklist)
novus-admin: thanks team, we'll stand by for the scheduled sync.
maria: closing for now — will reopen if p99 creeps. putting a calendar invite for 09:00 PST tomorrow for the enablement call.
